body:
zero9178 and jaxataxyou
Hacking, Unfair Advantage/Client

jax was using kill aura, speed, reach and fly, kill aura is slightly visible in the first clip but speed + fly in second clip.
Here are two youtube videos and i will tell you where to watch them


First Clip:https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aZnQ-wbFuyQ&feature=youtu.be watch at 1:25. he wasnt aiming at me. (jaxataxyou)

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
Hello Parabola1.

Thank you for taking the time to create this report.
The player jaxataxyou has been banned already (https://avicus.net/punishments/674324), but we'll use your evidence in case he tries to appeal.
Now regarding the player zero9178, sometimes there can be a visual glitch that lets a player appear like he is shifting and running at the same time, but the player started shifting after he was killed with is unusual.
I'll bring it up with the other moderators and we'll review the evidence and try to determine if he was hacking or not. We are going to notify you as soon as we reached to a verdict.

Regards Flo/resepignev :D
